outcome.answer: For converting dense retrieval into sparse retrieval, Latent Terms decomposes dense-retriever representations into sparse features suitable for BM25, without sparse-retrieval supervision [2]. LACONIC instead trains learned sparse retrievers to approach dense-model effectiveness while using less index memory [1]. Sparse autoencoders also underpin SPLARE, which learns sparse latent embeddings and reports gains in multilingual and out-of-domain settings [7].
